title: UK train announcements / Custom World Project
description: A resource pack which adds Train announcements to the Custom World Project
body: This is an Extension to the Custom World Project. Add this Resource pack to the world to have real railway announcements. These announcements will be used on the National Railway Services London (Underground, Overground and the DLR) Planes (Boarding music, safety video). This pack can also be used in your own Worlds but mostly used on the Custom World Project. This pack is still a work in progress and testing. Expect to add more sounds soon. For this to work you need the Minecraft Transit railway Mod as well as the Custom World Project. These sounds automatically work when the Resource pack is loaded into Minecraft.
